newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end down on campaign, Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end down on campaign, Q1 results.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended lower on Monday on weak sentiment because of violence in the election campaign and market talk of poor first quarter results from Semen Gresik, brokers and analysts said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 4.52 points, or 0.69 percent, to close at 652.55 points. Decliners led advancers by 76 to 45 with 61 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 293 billion rupiah against 448 billion rupiah on Friday.
